pk.context: 500 mcg oral, single dose, healthy adults

pill.desc: white to off-white, round, embossed tablet

tell: A PDE4 inhibitor for severe COPD whose N-oxide metabolite reaches about 10-fold the parent drug's plasma exposure.

clues.text: Absolute bioavailability is about 80%, and food does not change total absorption. About 99% is bound to plasma proteins, and the drug is extensively metabolized, with about 70% of radioactivity recovered in urine.
Molecular weight 403.2. A white to off-white, non-hygroscopic powder that is practically insoluble in water.
Approved under an NDA as 250 mcg and 500 mcg tablets, dosed once daily.
No boxed warning. Contraindicated in moderate to severe liver impairment; diarrhea and nausea are the reactions most often leading to discontinuation.
Reducing the risk of COPD exacerbations in patients with severe COPD associated with chronic bronchitis and a history of exacerbations.
A selective inhibitor of phosphodiesterase 4, which leads to accumulation of intracellular cyclic AMP in lung cells.
The generic name begins with R and has eleven letters.
